statement.notes: Only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was requested for extraction. The value is directly mapped from the 'Depreciation and amortization' line item in the operating activities section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. All other cash flow line items (e.g., net income, provision for credit losses, changes in trading assets) were not requested and are therefore not included in the output. The supplementary tables contain detailed breakdowns for operating leases and parent company cash flows, but these are not required for the single requested field.
